rule: The ML-DSA-65 record transcript: nine ASCII fields joined by single 0x00 bytes, no trailing 0x00: "nanorix-pqc-v1", cdp_version, capsule_id, key_id, signature_algorithm, pqc_algorithm, ed25519_public_key, pqc_public_key_fingerprint, canonical_hash_raw. See README.md.

pqc_public_key_source.name: NIST ACVP-Server ML-DSA-sigGen-FIPS204 (vsId 42)
